title: HTTP: Fix a comparison after a variable is now unsigned
description:
After queried_offset is unsigned, it can't be compared against > 0 to
test for it being -1. Use the new find functions. Simplify the
check by using a tvb subset.

Also get rid of the pattern in the Authorization header of checking
if an item is NULL before calling proto_item_add_subtree.
proto_item_add_subtree has its own NULL check, and returns a NULL
tree if the item is NULL, so this is redundant.

Fix #20995

Fixup 45578d04b389e6cb29c5dfa2551e9f8a0f545ce9
